data.one_liner: Lint rules for Dart and Flutter projects from Surf company.
data.what_it_does: Provides a curated set of const, error, and style lint rules specifically used by Surf for Dart and Flutter projects, building upon flutter_lints.
use_when: You want to apply Surf's coding standards and lint rules to your Flutter or Dart project.
You are looking to extend standard linting with a pre-configured set of error and style checks.
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter lints without external modifications.
You disagree with specific style or error rules bundled in Surf's configuration.
strengths: Pre-configured set of lint rules optimized for professional Flutter development.
Keeps up to date with recent flutter_lints and Dart versions.
weaknesses: Opinionated set of rules that may require overriding if they conflict with your team's style.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and include it in analysis_options.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official, standard lint rules provided by the Flutter team rather than a company-specific set.

alternatives.name: lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want the official Dart team lint rules.
